entities.name: Rona Robinson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rona Robinson was the first woman in the United Kingdom to gain a first-class degree in chemistry and one of the first documented female industrial chemists. She was also a British suffragette and paid member of the Women's Social and Political Union (WSPU).
